newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI sets 10-yr bond cut off at 13.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI sets 10-yr bond cut off at 13.05 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off rate of 13.05 percent at its auction of 10-year government bonds held earlier on Monday.
This is the first auction of dated government securities in financial year 1997/98 (April-March).
The cut-off rate at the last auction of 10-year bonds held in February was 13.65 percent.
The RBI said it received 293 bids for 81.14 billion rupees, of which it accepted 51 bids (16 of them partially) for 30.0 billion rupees.
The weighted average cut-off was 13.01 percent, RBI said.
